title: [BugFix][310P] fix Qwen3.5-w8a8 performance issue on the 310P
body:
### What this PR does / why we need it?
On Ascend 310P MRV2, #17278 restored Qwen3.5-2B MTP decode performance by skipping empty updatable-graph handshakes and avoiding redundant D2H syncs on the FULL ACLGraph path. Later #17461 remapped MTP verify attention state from `SpecDecoding` to `ChunkedPrefill` in shared helpers (validated on 910-class devices, not on 310P). The 310P eager gate still treats any non-`SpecDecoding` MTP batch as unsafe for FULL replay, so every uniform MTP step was forced to `CUDAGraphMode.NONE`. That erased the #17278 gains and regressed 2B-W8A8 decode by ~3× (TPOT ~64ms / ~15 tok/s vs ~22ms / ~45 tok/s) even though draft acceptance stayed healthy.

This PR is scoped to `_310p` only: promote uniform MTP verify back to `SpecDecoding` for InputBatch + the eager gate (MRv1 parity), align draft-prefill metadata with SpecDecoding capture, and resolve the GDN chunk FwdH op under both pre-/post-#17997 symbol names for stale extensions.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?
No. No new public APIs or config knobs. Behavior change is limited to Ascend 310P MRV2 speculative decoding / GDN chunk-op symbol resolution.

### How was this patch tested?

- Unit: tests/ut/_310p/test_model_runner_v2_310p.py (SpecDecoding promote + eager gate); tests/ut/_310p/spec_decode/test_mtp_mrv2_310.py (draft-prefill SpecDecoding).

- E2E (310P, NPU, VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1, IO=1024, TP1, BS1, 4 prompts, --no-enable-prefix-caching):

Qwen3.5-2B-W8A8 MTP: TPOT 22.7 ms, output 43.1 tok/s (was ~63.6 ms / ~15.6 tok/s).
Same setup no MTP: TPOT 21.9 ms, output 44.6 tok/s (MTP ≈ no-MTP; no severe MTP regression).

Other testing results for Qwen3.5-w8a8(MRv2) on the 310P:

Qwen3.5 | TP/IO/BS/num | TTFT | TPOT | Out tok/s | Total tok/s
-- | -- | -- | -- | -- | --
2B-w8a8 | 1-1024-1024-1-4 | 609.4 | 22.2 | 44.0 | 91.6
4B-w8a8 | 1-1024-1024-1-4 | 1139.6 | 35.5 | 27.34 | 56.9
9B-w8a8 | 2-1024-1024-1-4 | 851.2 | 32.1 | 30.36 | 63.44
35B-A3B-w8a8 | 2-1024-1024-1-4 | 1227.8 | 25.1 | 38.02 | 79.20
